title: Tokyo, Sunday Dec 20: Ikebukuro for Nicholas and family
lead: The same shops and the same two hour manga workshop. The only question is whether you draw first or shop first.
subject: Dec 20 tour: I choose
meet_text: Both plans start at the East Exit of Ikebukuro Station at 13:00. Plan A walks 5 minutes to the workshop first; Plan B goes straight into PARCO next door.
meet_hint: Ikebukuro is on the JR Yamanote line and three subway lines. From most of central Tokyo it is one train.
footer: Reply to Yuuki with the letter of the course you want. Times are approximate and can move on the day.
pick: Pick the order of your afternoon.
